annotationRationale: The first flips give an exhaustive partition for total probability. Independent uniform coordinates turn the final conditional probability into an area ratio, using elementary triangle areas.
sourceMethod: Follows the official three-case split according to the first flips, with a verbal description and explicit area calculation replacing reliance on the official shaded diagram.

review.mathCheck: The exhaustive first-flip cases contribute (1/4)(1/2)=1/8, (1/2)(1/2)=1/4, and (1/4)(1/4)=1/16. Their sum is 7/16, choice B. Endpoint atoms are counted separately, and continuous equality boundaries have probability zero.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Originally worded adaptation of official 2019 AMC 10A solution 22, pages 12–13. It preserves all three cases and correctly reconstructs the figure's two favorable triangles, each with legs 1/2.
review.annotationCheck: The partition, conditional probabilities and uniform-area model are fully explained. Assessed and supporting concepts are appropriately distinguished.

nativeLayerJudgments.US: 6.G.A.1 covers the triangle areas. No supplied US links cover total probability or uniform geometric probability.
